nodeDrag.details: Vertex 0 selection committed during the held gesture, the node moved materially to the requested position, release stopped movement, and clicks at the moved position toggled selection off and on.

outsideCanvasNodeDragTermination.details: Vertex 0 selection committed, the held drag crossed the canvas left edge and released outside, and two later empty-canvas pointer moves with no button pressed left the node and graph unchanged.

selectedPan.details: With vertex 0 selected, an empty-canvas (+60,-30) drag cleared selection and translated the graph; vertex 0 was then selected at its translated position.

unselectedPan.details: With no selection, a further empty-canvas (+40,-20) drag translated the graph; vertex 0 was then selected at its new translated position.

outsideCanvasPanTermination.details: A held pan crossed the canvas left edge and released outside. After returning, successive no-button movements produced no further translation or visible graph change.

mouseleave.details: Both real outside-canvas sequences crossed the canvas boundary and did not continue after return. Canvas-local mouseleave remained part of the composite defense.

windowMouseup.details: Real pointer release outside the canvas terminated both pan and node drag. The window-listener path is isolated independently in tests/stage5-corrective2-gesture-termination.test.mjs.

windowBlur.reason: The browser-control surface did not expose a safe isolated real-window blur action. The window blur listener is isolated in the corrective browser-DOM test; this artifact does not label the unperformed browser-only subcheck PASS.

nodeSelection.details: Node click selected vertex 0, node priority over ring remained correct, and repeated clicks toggled selection normally.

ringSelection.details: Clicking the visible h0 ring perimeter selected hyperedge h0 and displayed its metadata.

weightZero.details: The h0 list entry showed w0 and selected metadata showed weight: 0.

zoom.details: Pointer-centered wheel input changed the visible zoom from 100% to 115% and visibly changed the canvas transform.

resize.details: Viewport resize changed canvas CSS/backing width from 916 to 736, restored both to 916, preserved explicit vertex A selection, and preserved zoom state.

reheat.details: Force advanced visibly, the Reheat control was enabled, and Reheat produced additional visible movement.

viewSwitch.details: Hypergraph to Line Graph to Hypergraph completed with the expected edges=co-membership and rings=hyperedges states; no stale interaction resumed.

lodStatus.details: A 100-vertex hyperedge reported: Line Graph computed exactly. Previewing 4,000 of 4,950 edges using deterministic LOD; exports remain exact.

analyticalRefusal.details: A 3,000-vertex hyperedge reported Line Graph not computed because estimated 4,498,500 candidate-pair work units exceeded the 2,000,000 safety limit.
